title: SfIntelligence concept model — status-code taxonomy + edge semantics + reasoning concepts
description: Contract for the curator-owned concept-model YAML: packages/mcp/model/status-taxonomy.yaml (RM-0, key `statusCodes`), packages/mcp/model/edge-semantics.yaml (RM-1b, key `edgeSemantics`), packages/mcp/model/concepts.yaml (RM-2, key `concepts`), and packages/mcp/model/concept-rules.yaml (RM-2, key `conceptRules`). A single YAML file carries exactly one of these top-level keys. General Salesforce truth only: REST/API status codes, bare ComponentType and edge-type names, one extractor source marker (`formula-tokenizer`), save-order phase names, source-of-truth classes, and plain-English explanations / (category, verdict) pairs / reasoning summaries / structural rule predicates. This schema documents the shape the codegen (build-concept-model.mjs) validates in plain JS; it carries the same required-keys, type, and no-canonical-id constraints. Key ORDER in the YAML is significant and preserved into the generated artifact.

statusCodes.description: Map of UPPER_SNAKE REST/API status code to its category-level explanation.

concepts.description: RM-2 concept dictionary. Map of ConceptId (kebab-case, `concept:`-prefixed — NEVER a canonical `Type:Name` id) to its Concept entry.

conceptRules.description: RM-2 ordered list of ConceptRules binding a Concept to a structural predicate over a grounded slice.

docLink.description: A pointer to official Salesforce documentation for a Concept.

concept.description: A unit of generic, org-agnostic Salesforce reasoning knowledge. Carries NO canonical component ids.

kind.description: The ConceptKind category (a small closed union mirrored from @sf-intelligence/contracts).

summary.description: Plain-English generic Salesforce truth. Never org-specific.

rulePredicate.description: A STRUCTURAL matcher over a grounded slice. Matches by type and category ONLY — no component ids. Every supplied field is a conjunctive constraint. At least one field must be present.

edgeType.description: Match edges of this type (and constrain the predicate to an edge predicate).

componentTypes.description: Match nodes of these bare ComponentTypes (edge predicate: an endpoint must be one of these).

whereProperty.description: Match elements whose properties[key] strictly equals `equals`.

equals.description: The value to strictly equal (string, number, or boolean).

order.description: Match elements whose properties.order equals this value (a save-order phase index).

conceptRule.description: Binds a Concept (by id) to a structural RulePredicate and the interpretation to emit when it matches.

id.description: Rule id (`rule:`-prefixed slug — never a canonical component id).

concept.description: The ConceptId this rule interprets (must exist in concepts.yaml).

interpretation.description: Template with `{ids}` / positional `{0}` tokens filled from matched ids.

remediation.description: OPTIONAL authored, dependency-ordered fix STEPS for an actionable finding. Org-agnostic general Salesforce guidance only (never a canonical id, never a closure claim). Emitted on the interpretation with steps filled from the claim's grounded ids at the claim's confidence.

steps.description: Ordered fix-step templates (author order = execution order). Each may carry `{ids}` / positional `{0}` tokens.

whatIfTool.description: OPTIONAL pointer to a real registered tool that can MODEL the counterfactual (e.g. sfi.what_if_revoke_permset). Never a closure claim.

dependsOnCoverage.description: Bare ComponentType families the rule's honesty hinges on (may be empty).

category.description: Short category slug for the status code (e.g. validation-rule, access).

explanation.description: Plain-English cause. General Salesforce guidance; never org-specific.

producedByTypes.description: Bare Salesforce ComponentType names that can produce this code (may be empty for org-limit codes).

crossRefObjectAutomation.description: True when the usual producer is object automation (trigger / flow), so consumers cross-reference the object's triggersOn sources.

verdictPair.description: The (category, verdict) classification the safe_to_delete_field tool assigns to one incoming dependency edge.

category.description: Reasoning category slug (e.g. apex, flow, validation, unknown).

verdict.description: Per-edge verdict slug (e.g. blocking, risky, review).

edgeRule.description: Per-edge-type rule: a referrer-ComponentType-keyed verdict table plus a fallback verdict.

bySourceType.description: Map of bare referrer ComponentType name to its verdict pair (may be empty).

edgeSemantics.description: The safe-to-delete-field edge-semantics table (RM-1b). Lookup order: formulaTokenizer special case, then byEdgeType[edgeType].bySourceType[sourceType], then that edge type's default, then the top-level default.

formulaTokenizer.description: The SPECIAL case checked first: a `references` edge whose extractor source marker matches classifies as a formula reference regardless of the source node's type.

byEdgeType.description: Map of bare edge-type name to its per-edge-type rule.
